items.name: burpsuite-project-parser
items.author: trailofbits
items.description: Parse Burp Suite project files so an agent can systematically review web application security findings.
items.summary: The burpsuite-project-parser skill searches and extracts data from Burp Suite project files using the burpsuite-project-file-parser extension and a wrapper script. Developers use it when they need regex searches across response headers or bodies, security audit item dumps, or targeted proxy history and site map slices without opening the Burp GUI for every query. It delegates parsing to Burp Suite Professional rather than reading .burp files directly, and requires the BuffaloWill JAR extension installed through Burp Extender. The docs mandate sub-component filters such as proxyHistory.response.headers instead of full proxyHistory dumps that can return gigabytes. Investigation workflow starts with audit items, filters by severity and confidence, extracts affected URLs, then searches raw traffic with mandatory truncation. Hard limits include checking byte and line counts before retrieval, capping total output at 50KB, and truncating any response body field to 1000 characters. Platform configuration covers macOS, Windows, and Linux paths for BURP_JAVA and BURP_JAR environment variables used by burp-search.sh.
highlights: Wrapper script burp-search.sh delegates parsing to Burp Suite Professional via burpsuite-project-file-parser.
Sub-component filters return headers-only slices instead of gigabyte-scale full proxyHistory dumps.
Mandatory wc -cl size checks and 50KB head -c caps before any search output enters context.
Investigation workflow triages auditItems by severity and confidence before raw traffic searches.
Platform setup documents BURP_JAVA and BURP_JAR paths for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

items.summary: imagegen is an OpenAI Codex agent skill for creating and editing bitmap visuals such as photos, illustrations, textures, sprites, mockups, and transparent cutouts. It defines two top-level modes: the default built-in image_gen tool path that does not require OPENAI_API_KEY, and an explicit-only CLI fallback via scripts/image_gen.py with generate, edit, and generate-batch subcommands. The workflow starts by deciding intent (generate versus edit), whether output is preview-only or project-bound, and whether one asset or many variants are needed. Built-in mode saves under CODEX_HOME by default and requires moving project assets into the workspace before finishing. Edit mode applies to images already visible in conversation context; local file edits need view_image first or the CLI path when the user explicitly requests it. The skill forbids automatic CLI fallback, one-off SDK runners, and modifying image_gen.py. Prompt guidance lives in references/prompting.md and references/sample-prompts.md. Developers reach for it when AI-created raster assets beat SVG, HTML, or canvas for the task.
